intent.summary: Partitions available space into resizable adjacent panes separated by operable dividers.
useWhen: Pane proportions or visibility can change
avoidWhen: Content is navigation overlay rather than a persistent pane

semantics.childPolicy: two or more pane children with dividers between adjacent panes
semantics.sizing: pane sizes satisfy minimum, preferred, and maximum constraints within available space
semantics.ordering: pane order follows the inline or block axis

attributes.name: axis
attributes.description: Axis along which panes are divided.

attributes.name: dividerSize
attributes.description: Visual divider thickness; hit target may be larger.

constraints.message: A split view requires at least two panes.
Each pane sizing interval must be ordered.

accessibility.focusBehavior: dividers are focusable only when resizable
notes: Resizable dividers expose separator role, value, bounds, and keyboard adjustment.

mappings.strategy: Capture pane order, axis, constraints, and resizing semantics.
caveats: NavigationSplitView includes navigation policy beyond layout.

mappings.strategy: Use constrained Grid tracks and operable splitters for simultaneous panes.
caveats: WinUI SplitView is typically an overlay/navigation construct and is not always equivalent.
